title: Spectral Exploration
description: A fabric modpack based around magic and discovery through world exploration.
body:
The Spectral Exploration modpack is built primarily around **Spectrum**, which is a colorful magic mod that is discovery and exploration-focused. It’s complemented by additional magical content such as **Affinity**, a mod that offers more tech-like, automation-focused magic, **Hexalia**, a mod for witchery and plant-based magic, and **Malum**, a mod focused on the dark arts. When the elegance of magic is cast aside, the ugliness of brute-force technology is what remains - **NEEPMeat**’s dark and twisted biomechanical machines offer further automation and a method to commune with the eldritch! Use your newfound arcane knowledge to further explore and grow!

These main mods are enhanced by **Terralith** and **Tectonic**, which work together with many structure, mob, and dungeon mods to create a wide, majestic world, shown off by **Distant Horizons** and **Complementary** shaders. Warp pads offer a convenient but balanced method of long-distance travel between points of interest, and a collection of weapon, armor, and backpack mods offer a myriad of equipment to gear up with.

There’s also a focus on exploring with friends. New animations, emotes, an immersive first-person model, a ping system, and in-game **VOIP** encourage grouping up and setting off into the unknown. 

Taken together, this collection emphasizes new world generation and encourages discovery and engagement through exploration. See the sights, smell the flowers, and collect interesting blocks for a cool build. If you’re looking for something to do, the intended goal is to **thoroughly explore all focal content mods!**

Here are some highlights!
- New dimensions with Deeper and Darker, Paradise Lost, and the Bumblezone, as well as the deep, dangerous waters of Aquamirae.
- A host of new mobs ranging from mythical mounts and legendary boss monsters to river dragons and Ribbit villagers. 
- Base-oriented content such as Farmer’s Delight and board games. Take a load off and enjoy watching the seasons pass by once in a while.
- Options for interesting base design with gravity-controlling blocks and ziplines, as well as more traditional decoration mods such as handcrafted, chipped, and sooty chimneys. 
- Small Ships to cross and explore the vast oceans of Tectonic v3. Watch out for sea monsters!
- A suite of performance and optimization mods such as Sodium and Lithium. 

Total Item Count: 170
Curseforge Item Count: 2 (Backpacked and its dependency, Framework)
